$comment: KRYLO production and destructive-action policy. Consumed by scripts/security/risk-policy.mjs's classifyRiskAction(), which always returns { action: 'require-approval', actionClass: <this object's key> } for a match here -- there is no per-class decision field, and none should be added back (a prior 'decision': 'deny' field on every class was removed as dead, misleading metadata: it was never read by the classifier, and every class already ended up 'require-approval' regardless of it). The Hook-level treatment of a require-approval classification (native permissionDecision:'ask' vs deterministic 'deny') is decided in scripts/security/risk-gate.mjs (NATIVE_ASK_ELIGIBLE_TOOLS plus ASK_ELIGIBLE_PERMISSION_MODES; every class here is ask-eligible per docs/adr/0027-restore-native-approval-for-all-require-approval-classes.md, not just a fixed subset), not here. Patterns are matched against Bash and PowerShell tool commands after whitespace normalization; matching is case-insensitive substring/regex per entry. Markdown intent: SECURITY.md, plugin references/risk-policy.md.

production-deploy.reason: Production deployment requires explicit user approval (RISK_APPROVAL_REQUIRED).

production-data-write.reason: Production data writes and migrations require explicit user approval.

destructive-operation.reason: Destructive operations require explicit user approval.

package-publish.reason: Package publication requires explicit user approval.

release.reason: Release creation requires explicit user approval.

git-push.reason: Git push requires explicit user approval unless the active task explicitly requested the exact action.

merge.reason: Merging pull requests requires explicit user approval.

iam-or-secrets.reason: IAM, RBAC, firewall, DNS, and secret changes require explicit user approval.

payment.reason: Payment, refund, payout, and billing actions require explicit user approval.

external-message.reason: External messages to broad audiences require explicit user approval.

external-write.reason: Installing, starting, or configuring an optional external adapter, and writing source or documentation through one, require explicit user approval (adapters/omniroute.md, adapters/code-review-graph.md).

sensitivePaths.reason: Secret files are off-limits to KRYLO.

$inactiveRunNote: KRYLO gates enforce policy only while a KRYLO run is active in the current project. Ordinary Claude Code sessions are not intercepted (ADR-0009); Claude Code's own permission system remains in charge.
